public_content_review.conclusion: The reviewed aggregate RESULTS.json, metric RESULTS.csv and top-level review JSON files contain no participant-row data, private user contact details, detected absolute local paths or credential values. They can be included in an explicitly reviewed public export.
keep_nonpublic_or_exclude: controlled_joint_moments/private_runs/**: row-level tables plus launch/runtime receipts and logs; keep local under the stated export boundary.
controlled_joint_moments/__pycache__/**: local compiled cache; exclude from public export.
Private reviewer attachments, third-party papers and any patient-level data elsewhere are outside this allowlist and remain local.
public_content_review.scope_limit: This is a content check of the listed files, not blanket approval to publish the experiment directory recursively. The artificial covariance fixture may be disclosed after completion as described; it is not patient data.

nonblocking_notes: Discussion says the additional instruction gave no improvement; S13 and complete report correctly restrict this to one artificial diagnostic. Do not generalize to all ordinary versus instructed Agent workflows.

The complete report states all four laws imply the same quantities while immediately clarifying one probability law. Here four means four authored specifications, not four scientifically distinct distributions.
No new experiment or data access was performed in this documentation review.
